## 4. CPU time for one telemetry frame (emulated Cortex-M0+, 125 MHz)

| Step | Instructions | Cycles | Time |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| pack into the 22-byte frame (`tc_encode_tm`) | 3839 | 5333 | 42.7 us |
| write the same values as JSON (`snprintf`) | 21054 | 33972 | 271.8 us |
| unpack the frame (`tc_decode_tm`, PC side / tests) | 5013 | 6561 | 52.5 us |

Code size: `tc_encode_tm` 466 B, `bs_put` 100 B; the printf engine (`_svfprintf_r`) 584 B.
